about: Six fixed camera spots for the Connaught Place match (docs/CP_MATCH_PLAN.md). x, z in game metres, yaw as the game uses it (atan2 of the look direction in x, z). Centre of the Inner Circle (fitted, tools/measure_cp.mjs): 1044.2, -2100.4, radius 125.7. Spots are first guesses from geometry; adjust after looking and record the change in docs/CP_MATCH_LOG.md. Move the car with window.__next.city.transit.onTeleport(x, z, yaw).
